# Vendored dashboard assets

Served from `/static/vendor/` so the dashboard (and the macOS app) works offline and makes no
third-party requests. Upgrade by replacing a file with the same-named build of a newer version.

| file | project | version | license |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chart.umd.min.js` | [Chart.js](https://www.chartjs.org) | 4.5.1 | MIT |
| `highlight.min.js`, `github-dark.min.css` | [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org) | 11.12.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `marked.min.js` | [marked](https://marked.js.org) | 15.0.12 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.4.16 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| `fonts/*.woff2`, `fonts/fonts.css` | [Chakra Petch](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Chakra+Petch), [IBM Plex Sans / Mono](https://github.com/IBM/plex) via Google Fonts — latin, latin-ext, cyrillic, cyrillic-ext subsets | 2026-09 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
